releaseNotes:
Release v0.18.0

New Features:
- Dictionary to Key-Value List node (PS-234)

Bug Fixes:
- Write Script matches whole placeholder names in one pass (PS-236)
- glTF reader handles only triangle-list primitives and no longer panics on malformed files; glTF writer keeps all UV sets, textures and MIME types; Mesh Optimize keeps normals, UVs and materials with the geometry (PS-188)
- Exposed subgraph parameters no longer disable when a data connection is attached (PS-197)

Improvements:
- Guide: custom Python nodes continue on an error branch with status success (PS-237)
- Dependency updates (tauri 2.12, notify 8, quick-xml 0.42, glam 0.33, md5 0.8)
